Rebuilt. ON_DRAW was not a trigger name at all -- dispatch fell back to the raw string and matched nothing -- so 'whenever a hero draws a card during an action phase, THEY lose 1{h}' never fired. It is now a real trigger, dispatched to BOTH players' permanents because the card says 'a hero', not 'you'.

Both surviving clauses say 'they', which had no spelling: DRAW and LOSE_LIFE resolved only SELF/OPPONENT relative to the CONTROLLER, so 'they' could only be written as one of those and would be right half the time by accident. player EVENT_PLAYER reads draw_player off the event; player ACTIVE is whose phase it is.

The second and third clauses had ALSO been written as START_OF_TURN gated on DURING_TURN(ACTION_PHASE) and DURING_TURN(END_PHASE) -- conditions that are false at the start of a turn, since the start phase is neither.

NOT IMPLEMENTED: 'At the beginning of each hero's end phase, if a WEAPON DID NOT ATTACK this turn, destroy this.' No turn event records weapon attacks, which is the same gap kassai_cintari_sellsword is tracked for. Removed rather than left as an unconditional self-destroy at end of turn, which is what it was.
